h1: Custom Football Blankets for Game Day & Events
metaDescription: Shop custom football blankets with your logo. Perfect for game-day giveaways, tailgates, and corporate events. Order bulk blankets today.
introHtml: Custom football blankets let you combine team spirit with practical comfort at tailgates, watch parties, and corporate sports events. Unlike generic stadium blankets, these are printed or embroidered with your logo, mascot, or event date, making them memorable giveaways that fans will use season after season. Available in fleece, woven, or pique fabric, football blankets can be decorated with a full-color dye sublimation process for vibrant graphics or with tackle twill for a classic lettered look. Whether you need 50 blankets for a company suite or 500 for a promotional campaign, they fold compactly for easy distribution.
heroAltText: Custom football blankets with embroidered team logo, folded on a stadium seat at a game
